body.html:
Intuition atlases · CLI + grasp-of-relevance · two verdicts

The intuition atlas: instant grasp of relevance, zero inventions — and the traverser hallucinated first

79 agents · 3 experiments · CLI atlas 8/8 vs 4/8 at 586 tok · tier map: 0 inventions vs traverser's 1 · epic map SHIPS: 213 tok + laws sidecar

The thesis, stated and confirmed
A deliberately compressed optical map is not a document to work from — it is standing intuition: when an agent meets a detail cold, it already knows what the thing is, which law governs it, and which ONE file verifies it — instead of discovering that by traversal. Two experiments, both Opus 4.8: the map delivered placement quality matching free repo traversal (8.7 vs 9.3, beating or tying it on 6 of 8 details) at zero tool-turns, with zero invented relations — while the free traverser, with the whole repo in hand, tripped the invention flag once. The blurry map was the safer arm.

Experiment 1 — the whole CLI on one page (586 tokens)

123 manifest commands + client builtins + gotchas, one optical page as sole reference vs priors-only. Columns: arm · exact-command correct · invented verbs.

ArmCorrectInvented verbs
ATLAS8/80
NO-ATLAS4/8 (strictly 3/8)3
• The value is unknown-verb discovery — the misses were long-tail verbs priors can't supply: task stamp --criterion, ticket-key mint, task prime, onramp zed.
• The decisive safety cell: asked about priming, the no-atlas agent answered bp task next <worker> — a wrong-but-VALID mutating command that silently claims and strands a real task. Invented verbs self-correct (instant usage error); plausible-neighbor guesses that succeed do not. The atlas prevented exactly that class.
• Staleness is THE failure mode: a stale atlas converts self-correcting ignorance into confident wrong verbs — regeneration from GET /v1/capabilities must ride the CLI-freshness discipline, or do not adopt.

Experiment 2 — meeting a detail cold (the grasp-of-relevance test)

Eight real cold encounters (scope_to_workspace/3 in review, Repo.delete(workspace) in a diff, PHX_HOST=<IP> while debugging click-dead Studio, a @canonical marker, the post-merge hook…). INTUIT = 4k optical tier map, NO repo access; TRAVERSE = free Grep/Read, no map. Judged on placement (what is it · which law · which verify file) with a strict invented-relation flag. Columns: arm · mean placement · invented relations · tool-turns.

ArmPlacementInventedTool-turns
INTUIT (map only)8.70/80
TRAVERSE (free repo)9.31/8many/detail
• The map matched or beat traversal on 6/8 details — including a 10-vs-8 win where the traverser spent heavily AND tripped the invention flag (confidently claiming a @canonical marker was 'commented out' — the comment form IS its designed active state). Tool-turns can buy overconfidence.
• The map's failure mode was the safe one. Both misses (Bulldocs ingest binding, PubSub section) drifted toward the nearest legible card, explicitly hedged 'not sure, will not assert' — and still named a correct verification path. One tool-turn repairs each.
• The deficit is localized and fixable: both misses are the SAME thin spot — a multi-topic file (api/CLAUDE.md) whose section content lost salience to card filenames at 4k tokens. Nothing on the map was wrong; the fix is section-level headers for multi-topic files.
• Zero inventions was produced by map + abstention discipline together — the prompt forbids inventing; the map licenses placement and the verify-file choice, never assertion.

Experiment 3 — the generated epic map (SHIP, after a two-strike lesson)

An auto-generator (epic_map.py <keyword>) mines a live epic — latest wave papers, ready tasks, file skeletons (moduledoc gist + public defs), and the mined reference graph — into one 213-token page. Validated on the connectors epic with 6 cold details: 4/6 at traversal parity immediately; verdict SHIP-WITH-FIX on one invention.

• The invention was surgically diagnosable — and it took TWO fixes. The map truncated a moduledoc mid-sentence, cutting the trust-boundary clause; the reader filled the polarity from priors (claimed CloudPolicy governs self-hosted when self-hosted never touches it). Putting the polarity sentence verbatim ON THE IMAGE was not enough — the reader inverted it again. Only moving it to an authoritative TEXT sidecar, with the instruction 'the text file wins for any boundary claim', cleared the cell: 9/9.5, zero inventions, n=2.
• The generalized law: polarity is to meaning what a confusable hash is to strings. Unrecoverable from the blurry channel by construction — so it rides text, always. The epic map is the FGH posture applied to semantics: pixels carry shape (plan, skeletons, edges); text carries anything whose inversion is dangerous (boundary laws) plus a no-mid-sentence-truncation rule, since a dangling clause is a hallucination seed.
• Also fixed by the laws channel: the abstention cell (ConnectTicket) rose 2→9 — richer coverage in the same budget.

The atlas doctrine

Map for placement, traverse for truth
An intuition atlas is a few hundred to a few thousand tokens of standing context that changes where the agent looks first, never what it asserts. Rules: (1) verify-before-assert stays mandatory in the spawn prompt — grasp licenses the choice of verify file, every load-bearing claim gets its one traversal turn; (2) regenerate atlases on source change (CLI atlas from the capabilities manifest; staleness is worse than absence); (3) give multi-topic files section-level presence on the map; (4) keep each atlas one page — resistance to growth is a feature. Family so far: CLI atlas (586 tok, ADOPT-WITH-CAVEATS), doc-tier map (4k, YES-WITH-GUARDRAIL), epic map (same recipe per epic: plan + file skeletons + relevance edges — next build).
